title: Exmark Quest ZRT Riding Mowers Recalled Due to Crash Hazard
summary: Bearings supporting the riding mower's deck can fail and cause the deck to interfere with the operator's controls, resulting in a crash hazard. Units: About 2,200.

title: Farm Glass & Metal Spiral Tea Light Holder Recalled by Christmas Tree Shops Due to Fire Hazard
summary: Due to the design of the product, the tea lights can burn with a high flame, posing a fire hazard to consumers. Units: About 6,200.

title: Aqua-Leisure Recalls Children's Trampolines Due to Fall Hazard; Sold Exclusively at Toys "R" Us Stores
summary: Metal fatigue can cause the handlebar to break away during use, posing a risk of laceration from exposed metal surfaces or other injury from a fall. Units: About 40,000.

title: Circulon 13-Piece Cookware Set Recalled by Meyer Corporation Due to Laceration Hazard from Glass Lid
summary: The glass lid used with the 5-quart covered sauté pan can crack, break or shatter, posing a laceration hazard to consumers. Units: About 4,600.

title: Climbing Ropes Recalled by Porter Athletic Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The climbing rope can slip through the clamp that connects at the top, posing a fall hazard for climbers. Units: About 44.

title: Safety 1st Toilet and Cabinet Locks Recalled Due to Lock Failure; Children Can Gain Unintended Access to Water and Dangerous Items
summary: Young children can unexpectedly disengage the toilet locks and gain access to water in the toilet, posing the risk of drowning. The cabinet locks are being recalled because young children can disengage the lock, posing the risk of injury from dangerous or unsafe items stored in the cabinet. Units: A

title: Boys' Hooded Jackets Recalled by Bonded Apparel; Neck Drawstrings Pose Strangulation Hazard; Sold Exclusively at dd's Discounts
summary: The jackets have a drawstring through the hood which poses a strangulation hazard to children. Units: About 720.

title: Kennedy International Recalls Folding Step Stools Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The folding step stools can break or collapse unexpectedly when in use, posing a fall hazard to consumers. Units: About 1.6 million in the United States and 64,000 in Canada.

title: Reported Death, Severe Neck Injuries Prompt Recall of Banzai Inflatable Pool Slides Sold by Walmart and Toys R Us
summary: During use, the slide can deflate, allowing the user to hit the ground underneath the slide and become injured. The slide is also unstable and can topple over in both still and windy conditions and carries inadequate warnings and instructions. Units: About 21,000.

title: Salsa Cycles Recalls Bicycle Racks Due to a Fall Hazard
summary: The L-shaped mounting straps used to attach the bicycle rack to the front of the bicycle can break and cause the rack to fall while the bicycle is in use, posing a fall hazard to the rider. Units: About 1,100.

title: Supreme Trading Recalls Children's Letterman Jackets Due to Choking Hazard; Sold Exclusively at Dillard's
summary: Snaps on the jacket can detach, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 320.

title: Bassinets Recalled by Kolcraft Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The latches that attach the bassinet base onto the metal frame can appear to be locked in place but still remain unlocked. This allows the bassinet to become detached from the metal frame, causing the bassinet to fall and the infant to be injured. Units: About 46,000.

title: Trampolines Recalled by Sportspower Limited Due to Fall Hazard; Sold Exclusively at Walmart
summary: The netting surrounding these trampolines can break, allowing children to fall through the netting and be injured. Units: About 92,000.

title: Girls' Hooded Sweatshirts with Drawstrings Recalled by LANY Group Due to Strangulation Hazard; Sold Exclusively at dd's Discounts
summary: The sweatshirts have a drawstring through the hood which poses a strangulation hazard to children. Units: About 210.

title: Girls' Hooded Sweatshirts with Drawstrings Recalled by YMI Jeanswear Due to Strangulation Hazard; Sold Exclusively at dd's Discounts
summary: The sweatshirts have drawstrings at the hood that pose a strangulation hazard to children. Units: About 500.

title: Girls' Hooded Winter Jackets with Drawstrings Recalled by LA Fashion Hub Due to Strangulation Hazard; Sold Exclusively at dd's Discounts
summary: The jackets have a drawstring through the hood which poses a strangulation hazard to children. Units: About 2,300.

title: LaJolla Sport Recalls Boy's Hooded Flannel Shirts Due to Strangulation Hazard
summary: The hooded sweatshirts have drawstrings in the neck that can pose a strangulation hazard to children. Units: About 600.

title: M.M.M. Boys' Jogging Suits Recalled by Hot Chocolate; Waist Drawstrings Pose Entanglement Hazard; Sold Exclusively at dd's Discounts
summary: The jacket of this jogging suit has a drawstring at the waist that could become snagged or caught in small spaces or vehicle doors and it poses an entanglement hazard. Units: About 1,700.

title: Sonoma Valley Bar Stools Sold Exclusively at Havertys Furniture Recalled by Intercon Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The bolts attaching the top of the bar stool to the leg assembly can come loose, causing the seat to dislodge, resulting in a fall hazard. Units: About 2,350.

title: English Riding Supply Recalls Wire Mouth Bits for Horses Due to Risk of Injury
summary: The steel braided wire in the mouthpiece that connects the bit on either side of the horse's cheeks can become frayed, rusted or worn, which can cause the bit to break. If this happens, the rider can lose control and fall from the horse. Units: About 3,400.

title: ECHO Bear Cat Recalls Hydraulic Log Splitters Due to Impact Hazard
summary: The end cap of the log splitter's hydraulic cylinder can break away from the body of the log splitter, posing an impact hazard to the user or bystander. Units: About 120.

title: Toys R Us Recalls Imaginarium Activity Center Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The small wooden knobs attaching the xylophone keys to the end can detach, causing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 24,000.

title: Kitchen Table and Chair Set Recalled by Stoneberry Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The chairs can collapse during normal use, causing a fall hazard. Units: About 200.

title: Select Brands Recalls Kitchen Selectives Blender Due to Laceration Hazard
summary: While in operation, the plastic pitcher can separate from the blade assembly, leaving the blade assembly in the base and exposing the rotating blades. This poses a laceration hazard to consumers. Units: About 4,069.

title: Chicago Century Furniture Corp. Recalls Mattresses for Violation of Federal Mattress Flammability Standard
summary: The mattresses fail to meet the mandatory federal open flame standard for mattresses, posing a fire hazard to consumers. Units: About 340.

title: Clip-on Desk Lamps Sold At Lowe's Stores Recalled Due to Shock Hazard; Made by He Shan Lide
summary: The power cord for the lamp can detach where it meets the clamp, exposing energized wires, posing an electric shock risk to consumers. Units: About 33,000.

title: Cooper Lighting Recalls Commercial Reflector Assembly with Glass Lens Due to Injury Hazard
summary: The reflector can fall out of its fixture to the ground, which could result in an injury hazard. Units: About 21,000.

title: Bicycle Stems Recalled by Ridley Bikes Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The bicycle handlebar stems can crack or break, posing a fall hazard. Units: About 105.
